operations.description: GM: add positive amounts to explicitly named safe system.* numeric attributes on an Actor. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and a GM execution runtime. An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.

GM: add positive amounts of registered currencies to an Actor using structured denominations; formulas and dice are not accepted. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and a GM execution runtime. An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.

GM: add quantities from resolved Item UUIDs to an Actor. remove_existing_items explicitly replaces the existing inventory when true. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and a GM execution runtime. An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.

Calculate structured registered primary currency amounts. Provide either other_currencies (subtract defaults to true) or a nonnegative multiplier. Secondary currencies are excluded because 3.3.4 combines them incorrectly; no dice or formulas are accepted.
Calculate whether one existing Item can fit in a vault, without moving it. Reports either a new position or an existing stack item ID; the result does not reserve space.

GM: combine distinct source item piles into a target Actor using configured item exclusions. Verifies no positive eligible source stock remains, then returns deltas and deleted token IDs. Upstream commits are not atomic; an uncertain result requires inspection. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and a GM execution runtime. An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.

GM: convert explicit Token UUIDs into enabled Item Piles with allowlisted settings. Linked tokens also update their shared Actor. Token appearance overrides may be adjusted by Item Piles display rules. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and a GM execution runtime. An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.

GM: create an empty pile Actor, optionally placing a token at an explicit Scene position. scene_uuid is always required. An existing actor_uuid requires position; omit actor_uuid to create a new Actor. Add inventory separately with add_items using the returned actor_uuid (the token Actor for an unlinked token); base_actor_uuid identifies its base Actor. Actor-only creation uses a linked prototype. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and a GM execution runtime. An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.

GM: delete one Item Piles Token and confirm its removal from its parent Scene. Actor-only piles are not deleted by this operation. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and a GM execution runtime. An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.
Read configured Actor currencies as numeric summaries. get_all includes zero balances; secondary includes secondary currencies (default true).
Read global currency definitions, abbreviations and system quantity/price paths. An optional Actor selects its primary currency; other definitions remain global.
Read localized system item categories and custom Item Piles categories.

Quote payment options for one item. quantity counts purchases; units_per_purchase and requested_units show the actual item units. A buyer enables affordability checks; quotes do not reserve stock or lock prices.

quantity.description: Number of purchases; each purchase contains the configured number of item units.

operations.description: Read an Actor inventory through the Item Piles public API, preserving the existing item summary contract.

actor_uuid.description: Actor UUID in the selected target world.

operations.description: Read effective merchant buy/sell modifiers, optionally for a particular Actor. absolute=true excludes merchant base modifiers.

Quote payment and change for structured primary currency amounts, optionally checking an Actor and quantity. Secondary currencies are excluded because the inspected parser can charge them twice. Quotes do not reserve funds.

Read the public pile state and allowlisted container, merchant, sharing, and vault settings for an Actor or Token UUID. Macros and arbitrary extension flags are omitted; vaultAccess is configured access, not a player authorization decision.

Read a vault grid, occupied item summaries, and actual free cells. free_spaces is free_cells.length; upstream_free_spaces preserves the upstream item-count estimate, which can differ for multi-cell items. grid is indexed [x][y].
Inspect an item through public Item Piles quantity, base-cost, validity, and stacking helpers; optionally evaluate stacking for an Actor.

Preview a multi-item vault fit using existing Item UUIDs and explicit quantities. Nonstackable quantities must be integers and expand into separate items, with at most 100 item placements considered. Nothing is moved, deleted, or reserved. merged_source_item_ids identifies inputs merged into stacks; upstream does not return complete existing-stack quantity updates, so this preview is not a write plan.

GM: populate a merchant from its configured roll tables. remove_existing_items is required explicitly because true clears existing stock before replenishment. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and a GM execution runtime. An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.

GM: remove positive amounts from safe system.* attributes, rejecting requests above the current numeric balance. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and a GM execution runtime. An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.

GM: remove positive registered primary currency amounts using the public API affordability check. Secondary currencies are excluded because the inspected parser can charge them twice. change=false affects preflight only. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and a GM execution runtime. An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.

GM: remove explicit positive quantities of exact embedded item IDs from an Actor, checking the available stock before invocation. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and a GM execution runtime. An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.

GM: disable Item Piles on explicit Token UUIDs and verify the resulting state. Linked tokens also disable the shared Actor; documents and inventory are retained. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and a GM execution runtime. An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.

GM: roll one exact RollTable UUID and optionally add the results to an Actor. This is a write even without a recipient; reset, normalization, chat and replacing inventory default to false. Text results may also credit currencies, but returned item deltas do not confirm monetary effects: read get_currencies afterward to inspect balances. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and a GM execution runtime. An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.

GM: set explicitly named safe system.* numeric attributes on an Actor, including zero. Returns upstream attribute deltas. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and a GM execution runtime. An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.

GM: explicitly open, close, lock, or unlock a container through its public API and verify both flags. Opening also unlocks; locking also closes. Public hooks and configured sounds still run. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and a GM execution runtime. An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.

GM: split a lootable pile among explicit distinct recipient Actors. Requires shareCurrenciesEnabled or splitAllEnabled because upstream 3.3.4 otherwise can remove currencies without crediting recipients, including currencies inside Items. Item sharing still follows shareItemsEnabled. Source and recipient changes are sequential upstream; empty piles may be deleted. Uncertain results are never retried. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and a GM execution runtime. An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.

GM: buy or sell ONE item line through Item Piles tradeItems, exchanging payment and change. quantity counts purchases; validates the positive whole item units implied by the configured units-per-price value, actual stock and payment affordability. Never retries an uncertain result. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and a GM execution runtime. An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.

quantity.description: Number of purchases; each purchase contains the configured number of item units.

operations.description: GM: transfer all positive configured attribute-currency balances present on both Actors. Uses public transferAttributes to avoid the 3.3.4 transferAllAttributes defect and emits its hooks. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and a GM execution runtime. An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.

GM: transfer all configured item and attribute currencies between different Actors through the public API, including secondary currencies. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and a GM execution runtime. An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.

GM: transfer all eligible non-currency items between different Actors. Optional item_filters override configured exclusions. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and a GM execution runtime. An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.

GM: transfer positive amounts of safe system.* attributes between different Actors, checking the source balance before invocation. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and a GM execution runtime. An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.

GM: transfer positive primary currency amounts between different Actors with affordability preflight. Secondary currencies are unsupported by this 3.3.4 transfer method; change=false affects preflight only. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and a GM execution runtime. An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.

GM: transfer all eligible items and configured currencies between different Actors. The upstream transaction is not atomic and may delete an emptied source pile token. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and a GM execution runtime. An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.

GM: transfer explicit positive quantities of exact embedded item IDs between different Actors. Source stock is checked before the public API call. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and a GM execution runtime. An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.

GM: set registered attribute-currency totals, including explicit zero. Item-backed currencies are rejected because the inspected 3.3.4 setter does not honor their requested totals. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and a GM execution runtime. An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.

GM: update Actor-specific merchant buy/sell modifiers and verify the observed settings. Both amounts are required, including relative updates. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and a GM execution runtime. An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.

GM: update allowlisted pile settings and verify requested values after the public API returns. actor_uuid accepts Actor or Token UUIDs; token_settings requires a Token UUID. Updates can affect all active tokens sharing the Actor. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and a GM execution runtime. An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.
